test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In the given question, a sentence is divided into four parts and given in the alternatives (A), (B), (C), and (D). There is an error in one part. Choose the alternative containing that part of the sentence that has the error. Choosing the alternative with the error will be the answer.

The only disadvantage with teaching is repeating the same curriculum again and again.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the use of the preposition "**with**" after the noun "**disadvantage**."
 
• Certain nouns take specific prepositions to form a standard collocation. When referring to a drawback or a negative feature of something, the preposition "**of**" is used.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**disadvantage of teaching**," which correctly identifies the activity to which the disadvantage belongs.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The only **disadvantage of teaching** is repeating the same curriculum again and again."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "The only" **– This part is grammatically correct as it functions as a determiner identifying a specific singular noun.
 
• **Option 3: "is repeating the same"** – This part is correct; "repeating" acts as a gerund serving as the subject complement.
 
• **Option 4: "curriculum again and again."** – This part is correct. While "again and again" might seem redundant with "repeating," it is a common idiomatic expression used for emphasis to show monotony.
 
• **Usage of 'Disadvantage to':** We use "disadvantage to" when referring to a person or group that is negatively affected (e.g., "The new tax is a disadvantage to low-income families").
